lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: if you're free, would you like to go shopping with me?
Is there something you want to buy in particular?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Yes, I need to buy some new clothes.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'm looking for something to wear when I hang out with Vesti and Eunhwa on our next day off.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I thought it'd be nice if you helped me pick something out, hehe.
Didn't you say you bought something not long ago?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You remembered!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: That's right, Commander. T_T

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I did buy something that I really liked.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Before I did that, I thought the size might be a bit tight,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: but I liked it so much that I just went ahead and got it.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: But sure enough... T_T When I tried it on,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: it ripped right away! orz

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: So I sent it for alterations,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: but it looks like that'll take some time.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: My next day off is for two days,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: so I need to get a new outfit.
Do your clothes often get ripped?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Fairly often, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: The worst part is that it's always the same spot that ends up ripping :(
Where exactly?
That must be upsetting.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: it's a bit embarrassing to say... >.<

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Just use your imagination, Commander! ;)

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It really is! T_T

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: No matter how careful I am,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: it always happens...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: That's why I'd love for you to help me out this time, Commander!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Tell me if the clothes I pick fit me okay,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: and if they look good on me too!
If it's a sizing issue...
How about getting some custom clothes made?
Why not get them altered before you wear them?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my goodness!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: That's a wonderful idea!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: If I bring them the design I want,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: they can make it just like that, right?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: How exciting, hehe!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh, but...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my goodness!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: That's a really great idea, but...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I think I'm a little short on time to make it happen right now. T_T

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Still, I'll definitely try it next time!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Thanks for the wonderful suggestion, Commander! :D

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: For today, I'll just have to trust your fashion sense, hehe.
Okay, leave it to me.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my, how reassuring!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: All right, let's meet in front of the Shopping Mall in an hour!
